metadata.datasource:
Prepared for Negs from the manufacturer's datasheet: Agfa Technical Data PF, Range of Professional Films, 1st edition, 09/1998, PDF page 8 (spectral sensitivity, characteristic curves, minimum and midscale-neutral spectral density; RMS granularity 3.5). PDF sha256 982d920110a598a910e7f31f7fa2d7446f4238d84408ae83bfa32e92d1188d79. Data (c) Agfa-Gevaert AG. The curves were read from the PDF's vector paths (tools/film_profiles/extract_pdf.py); the points and axis calibration are in data/profile-sources/agfa-pf/agfa_portrait_xps_160/.
Method: spektrafilm's public-era profile creator by Andrea Volpato (commit b2c7fe6), steps 1-8: D-min removed, log E zero where green is 0.2 over D-min plus 3 stops, dye spectra reconstructed (dmid_dmin) from spektrafilm's generic_a dye set (Giorgianni, Madden & Kriss 2009, p. 112, via spektrafilm) because the datasheet gives no per-dye spectra, status-M unmixing, a 3 norm_cdfs curve fit, sensitivity balance, midscale alignment 'mid' (of none/green/mid, the lowest grey-ramp neutrality error, none 0.068, green 0.074, mid 0.061, among those whose kodak_portra_endura neutral filters fall in the shipped films' range), densitometer normalisation. Then Negs's steps: sensitivity scaled so an 18.4 % grey gives raw exposure 1 per channel under the reference illuminant, and spektrafilm's grey-ramp refinement run on spektrafilm 28bf883 through kodak_portra_endura at data_trustability 0.3. hanatos2025 adaptation window [421.7, 26.5, 593.1, 36.0] fitted on the reflectance corpus (Otsu (https://github.com/enneract/otsu2018), Munsell (https://zenodo.org/records/3269912), human skin (https://www.nist.gov/programs-projects/reflectance-measurements-human-skin), forest colors (https://zenodo.org/records/3269920)) with a weak prior toward the median of spektrafilm's stored windows. Tools and procedure: tools/film_profiles, docs/adding-film-stocks.md.
Negs choices: reference illuminant D55 (daylight stock, exposed at 5400 K); viewing illuminant D50; target print kodak_portra_endura; log_sensitivity_density_over_min 1.0 as printed; spectra left empty (null) outside the published wavelength range; characteristic curves in log10 H as printed; use 'still' and antihalation 'weak' as the shipped still portrait negatives (Kodak Portra 160, Fujifilm Pro 160S).
Note: Negs has no Agfacolor RA-4 print paper; refined against kodak_portra_endura as the portrait RA-4 reference paper.
Note: The characteristic y-axis fits the 7 interior gridlines (0.5..3.5 D) and top frame edge (4.0 D); the bottom box border sits ~1.03 pt below the uniform 0.0 D gridline spacing (the '0' text label aligns with the gridline spacing, not the box edge).
Recorded validation exception: the reconstructed dyes reproduce D-mid minus D-min within 0.034 D (worst at 405 nm, the chart's blue edge), over the 0.03 D criterion; the §D3 fallback (a flat extension past 700 nm) was not tried, as the worst point is not near 700 nm. Weighted per kodak_portra_endura print channel the residual is R/G/B +0.0005, +0.0058, +0.0000 D, within the 0.01 D the method accepts for this case (approved by Noah 2026-11-14).
